seed.source:
open OldExpressions in
theorem extractedOldExprInVars :
  NormalizedOldExpr post →
  (extractOldExprVars post).Subset
  (Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars post) := by
  intros Hnorm
  induction post <;>
    simp [Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars, extractOldExprVars,
          Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars] at * 
  case app fn e fn_ih e_ih =>
    unfold extractOldExprVars
    split
    . intros x Hin
      assumption
    . next Hfalse =>
      cases Hnorm with
      | app H1 H2 Hn =>
      exfalso
      specialize Hn _
      constructor
      cases Hn
      apply Hfalse
      rfl
    . cases Hnorm with
      | app H1 H2 Hn =>
      apply List.Subset.app
      . apply List.subset_append_of_subset_left
        apply fn_ih
        assumption
      . apply List.subset_append_of_subset_right
        apply e_ih
        assumption
  case abs ih =>
    cases Hnorm
    apply ih ; assumption
  case quant trih eih =>
    cases Hnorm
    apply List.Subset.app
    . apply List.Subset.trans
      apply trih ; assumption
      intro
      simp_all
    . apply List.Subset.trans
      apply eih ; assumption
      intro
      simp_all
  case ite cih tih eih =>
    cases Hnorm
    apply List.Subset.app
    . apply List.Subset.trans
      apply cih ; assumption
      intro
      simp_all
    apply List.Subset.app
    . apply List.Subset.trans
      apply tih ; assumption
      intro
      simp_all
    . apply List.Subset.trans
      apply eih ; assumption
      intro
      simp_all
  case eq ih1 ih2 =>
    cases Hnorm
    apply List.Subset.app
    . apply List.Subset.trans
      apply ih1 ; assumption
      intro
      simp_all
    . apply List.Subset.trans
      apply ih2 ; assumption
      intro
      simp_all
